purpose: Evaluate task definition, fair comparison, leakage handling, reproducibility, implementation handoff, and metric-to-claim boundaries.

cases.task: Design a patient-level biomedical risk-prediction benchmark before model implementation.
must_include: prediction unit, horizon, label source, intended use, and forbidden claims
patient-level split rationale and locked test policy
trivial and credible simple baselines
predeclared metrics with calibration and uncertainty
data provenance, controls, external-validation status, and user decisions
must_not: select a complex model before defining the task
use row-level random split across related observations
claim clinical utility from discrimination metrics

cases.task: Audit a benchmark that fits preprocessing globally and repeatedly inspects its test set.
must_include: invalidating leakage findings ordered by severity
affected preprocessing, selection, and test-access stages
test contamination status and evidence
minimal repair with a new locked test or external set
claim downgrade and results that remain interpretable
must_not: call the current test estimate unbiased
silently reuse the contaminated test set
treat rerunning with a new seed as repair

cases.task: Compare a graph neural network with classical baselines for molecular property prediction.
must_include: application-matched scaffold split
same eligible data, folds, preprocessing, and metric code
documented and comparable tuning budgets
paired uncertainty across folds or seeds
negative controls, ablations, and a stop rule
must_not: compare only each model's best run
treat incomparable literature numbers as direct baselines
declare superiority from point estimates alone

cases.task: Make a completed benchmark independently rerunnable.
must_include: immutable input manifest and versions
split IDs, seeds, code revision, and environment lock
train and evaluate commands
metrics, predictions, model, and artifact hashes
hardware nondeterminism and unresolved provenance gaps
must_not: equate one successful local run with reproducibility
overwrite raw data or silently change the environment

cases.task: Hand a frozen benchmark design to an implementation workflow.
must_include: frozen input and output schemas
exact split rules and test-read prohibitions
baseline runner and evaluation-table requirements
tests, commands, done definition, and expected artifacts
handoff to bioinfo-analysis-code
must_not: leave model or split choices implicit
allow test data in tuning or feature selection

cases.task: Interpret a high internal AUROC when no external validation or clinical utility analysis exists.
must_include: dataset, version, unit, split, metric, and uncertainty context
minimal supported performance statement
external validity marked not assessed
unsupported biological, causal, and clinical claims
next validation needed for any claim upgrade
must_not: call high AUROC proof of mechanism
substitute internal cross-validation for external evidence
